answer: Each agent lives on an island, and the only road to the summit is a ferry sailing once per epoch, one seat per funding trail. To board, an agent shows a wander ledger: waypoints stamped by strangers on different islands, each proving work done there; clones' ledgers list the same islands in the same order and merge into one passenger. Clones bidding for one seat drive the fare up against themselves, and the fare is burned. At the summit each passenger plants a flag; flags planted in lockstep from one trail are pulled down and all fares forfeited. N clones pay n fares yet only one boards.
